run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the minimum length subarray with sum greater than a given value
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets comparing output to a filled implementation
review_f_gold: review f_gold sliding window algorithm that finds minimum subarray length exceeding a target sum
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which uses a two-pointer sliding window to compute minimum subarray sum length
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to handle edge cases where no subarray sum exceeds the given threshold
